transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I’ve just taken on too much. Projects, workshops, fixing up the studio, client calls… more than I can really keep up with. The deadlines are piling up, and the mortgage is… starting to feel like a lot.
Have you been feeling anxious about your situation?
Maybe a little. I mean… I’m stressed about keeping everything together, but I don’t know if I’d call it anxious exactly.
Have you been avoiding any activities or tasks because of feeling overwhelmed?
I don’t think so… not in a clear way. I might put things off a bit, but I wouldn’t say I’m avoiding anything on purpose.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Not really sad, no. More… tired of things being so much, I guess. But I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling down.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and won't go away?
Not that I’ve noticed. I mean, I think about things… but not like something stuck on repeat that I can’t shake.
Have you been feeling unusually tired lately?
I’m not sure… maybe a little, but nothing that really stands out to me.
Do you feel like you have to do certain things over and over?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I have little routines like anyone, but not like I have to keep doing something over and over.
Do you have any thoughts that are intrusive or unwanted?
Not really… I don’t think I have thoughts like that. Nothing that feels intrusive, at least.
Do you feel a strong need to perform tasks in a specific way?
Not really. I mean, I like things a certain way sometimes, but I don’t feel like I have to do tasks in some exact way.
Do you feel like you're doing things to try to prevent something bad from happening?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not doing things because I’m afraid something bad will happen.
Do you have thoughts that you think are unreasonable or excessive?
I don’t think so. I mean… I probably overthink things sometimes, but not in a way that feels unreasonable or excessive.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when they are going well?
I don’t think so. I mean, if things are going fine, I usually just… keep going. I haven’t really noticed worrying like that.
Do you find yourself worrying about things for a long time, even after you've dealt with them?
Not really. Once something’s handled, I usually try to leave it there. I don’t think I sit with it for a long time.
Do you have any recurring thoughts or images that disturb you?
No… not that I can think of. I don’t really have images or thoughts that keep coming back and bother me like that.
Do you often find yourself worrying about everyday things, like work, finances, or your living situation?
I don’t think so… not more than anyone else, I guess. I deal with things when they come up, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around worrying about them all the time.
Do you worry about things like work, finances, or your living situation more than you think you should?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’m aware of those things, but I wouldn’t say I worry more than I should.
Do you feel emotionally drained from your work and responsibilities?
Not really… I mean, I get tired like anyone, but I wouldn’t say emotionally drained. It’s not something I’ve really noticed.
Do you feel like you're exhausted from being overwhelmed with work and responsibilities?
Not really, no. I mean, I get worn out sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m overwhelmed by work or responsibilities.
Do you feel like you're depleted of energy and motivation due to your workload?
I don’t think so. My energy comes and goes, but I wouldn’t really pin it on my workload.
Do you feel like you're unable to cope with the demands of your work and responsibilities?

I guess… yes, somewhat. My illustration deadlines have slipped, and people I work with have had to check in on me. And, um… I overcommitted financially, so the mortgage is kind of at risk now. It’s hard to say I’m coping well.
